known.article: Tierra del Vino de Zamora DO
known.via: English Wikipedia "Tierra del Vino de Zamora (DO)" (redirects to "Tierra del Vino de Zamora DO")

communes: Cubo De Tierra Del Vino, El

climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A Zamora province appellation in Castile and León. Its rules cover wine from red Tempranillo, Garnacha Tinta and Cabernet Sauvignon, and from white Verdejo, Godello, Albillo Mayor and Palomino.
